question: The single-angle family binds a category to a role at 2 referents, 2 events and 24 nouns, and composition costs it 0.004. Does any of that survive when the cast grows, the story lengthens, and the noun inventory becomes a real one -- and if it degrades, is the degradation in the TASK or in the CIRCUIT?

T2.thinness_note_doc63_SS12_5_1: THE T = 2 PAIR IS THIN AND IS REGISTERED AS THIN: n <= T + 1 allows only n in {2, 3}, one step of cast size. `gap_stable_in_n_T2` is a TWO-POINT statement and is the weakest of the three; T = 4 and T = 6 are where the n axis is actually measured, and any summary that quotes the three booleans as equivalent evidence is WRONG.

branches_doc63_SS12_6.B1_freedom_is_the_encodings: cc(n) <= 0.06 at every n; the coefficient budget does not grow with T, only depth does

n2_T2.FLAGGED_no_I24_bound_exists: AMBIGUITY F7. SS6.3 states that 'both levels' grade-1 bounds are computed in the pre-work (SS2.6) so the capacity change is known before the accuracy change is seen', but `diagnostic_scaling_bounds.json` (produced 2026-08-29) carries NO I24 contrast row -- the 24-noun subset is drawn at build time at the registered seed SEED + 24 and did not exist when the instrument ran. NO I24 BOUND IS INVENTED HERE. This costs the run nothing mechanical: SS12's preamble makes it mechanical that NO CRITERION READS A BOUND, and SS15 lists the bounds as CONTEXT ONLY. It costs the READING the separation SS14 wants between 'the inventory made the TASK harder' and 'the inventory made the TRAINING harder', so `inventory_costs` is reported WITHOUT that discriminator and the gap is flagged rather than papered over. Computing it is one bound plus a reused null (~15 s) and is a decision for the orchestrator, not for this aggregator.

read_condition_doc63_SS12_9_3.rule: grade 3 is READ iff the reference arm clears its own procedure-matched floor: heldout_mean(faail_camel @ 2,2) >= floor_mean + 2 * floor_sd
read_condition_doc63_SS12_9_3.why_not_binds: SS12.4.1 makes a `binds` gate SELF-DEFEATING: the 0.65 bar sits ABOVE faail_camel's 0.6426 pair-level bound, so gating on it would make grade 3 unreadable BY ARITHMETIC on the one run in this programme's history that finally has a target for it. Floor clearance answers 'did this arm learn anything from the labels', which is the only precondition a conversion ratio needs. This is NOT a weakened bar; it is the CORRECT bar for this question, and 0.65 is not re-chosen -- it is not used.
read_condition_doc63_SS12_9_3.FLAGGED_stale_text_in_SS18_4: SS18.4's gating list still reads 'grade 3 (only after binds_n2_T2 for faail_camel is TRUE, SS12.9.3)'. That parenthetical is superseded by SS12.9.3's own text and by SS12.4.1's ruling that the gate WAS REWRITTEN to floor clearance. This aggregator implements SS12.9.3 and flags the stale wording rather than inheriting it.

grade3_doc63_SS12_9.why_the_headroom_form_doc63_SS12_9_1: the obvious form heldout/bound is DEGENERATE NEAR CHANCE -- both terms compress toward 0.5, so an arm at 0.52 against a 0.5298 bound scores 0.98 while an arm at 0.60 against a 0.6426 bound scores 0.93, and the flag would fire BACKWARDS for a purely arithmetic reason. The headroom form divides the excess over chance by the AVAILABLE excess over chance.
grade3_doc63_SS12_9.why_both_cells_are_at_n2_doc63_SS12_9_2: SS2.8: NO grade-1 bound exists at n > 2 -- `capacity_check.py`'s scope statement is that the instrument is not a bound on tasks with more than two referents. A conversion criterion needs a bound in its denominator, so grade 3 can only be read where the pre-work's instrument applies.

registered_expectations_doc63_SS12_9_4.why: band_32arc's bound is 0.5298, so an arm binding at 0.65 would exceed its own reachable ceiling by 0.12 and would be a bug_hunt event; faail_camel's is 0.6426 and the 0.65 bar meets a 519-noun inventory. NEITHER IS A FAILURE OF ANYTHING.

grade3_doc63_SS12_9.scope: a PREDICTION-GRADE result about the BOUND instrument -- NOT a finding about wazn, about morphology, or about scaling. It says the bound's null percentile carries information about trainability; nothing more. One target, one cell, five seeds, after three rungs with none: real, and thin (SS23 item 3a).

verdict_reasons.composition_free_at_scale: cc(2) = 0.0107 over T in {2,4,6} and cc(4) = 0.0180 over T in {4,6}, both against the 0.06 bar. THE CRITERION READS ONLY n = 2 AND n = 4 and the reason is the grid's SHAPE: n <= T + 1 makes the grid TRIANGULAR, so the frontier cells (3,2), (5,4) and (7,6) each exist at exactly one T and no T-axis spread is defined for them (SS12.6, SS23 item 4). The composition question is therefore answered at cast sizes 2 and 4, NOT at 7 -- and 7 is exactly where branch B2 predicts the collapse.
verdict_reasons.inventory_costs: SS12.7: `inventory_costs = (heldout_mean(I24) - heldout_mean(I519) >= 0.06) at (2,2) OR at (4,4), reported per cell`. Measured deltas: {'n2_T2': -0.0113, 'n4_T4': 0.0287}. AMBIGUITY FLAGGED: SS12.7 writes 'at (2,2) or at (4,4)' without settling whether the boolean is the OR or a per-cell pair; this file implements the OR and reports BOTH cells so either reading is recoverable. Read together with the two levels' pre-work bounds (SS2.6) so a drop that TRACKS the bound is separated from one that does not.

verdict_reasons.anchor_replicates_exp69: doc 63 SS6.4, the SIXTH enforced use; bit_exact_all = True. IF THIS FAILS the exp76 pipeline has drifted, every scaling number is a comparison against a moving baseline, and NOTHING ELSE IN THE RUN IS READ.
verdict_reasons.inert_padding_control_holds: doc 63 SS8.3 / SS12.2, asserted at smoke with the all-wires-readout build that MUST fail it: max |padded - unpadded| = 1.192e-07 against the 1e-6 bar, and the broken build moved by 4.392e-01. If it fails, SS4.4's theorem is not implemented and every n_active label in the run is wrong.
verdict_reasons.comparator_flat_in_n: doc 63 SS10.4: a comparator that MOVES along n has caught a leak -- an n-dependent information channel the V-suite missed, or a core that was not shared. BLOCKING: if it fails, the n-axis cells are not read, SS12.5's booleans are stored as null (NEVER as FALSE), and the finding is a GENERATOR DEFECT. Why 1e-9 and not 0.02: doc 55 SS6.7's tie band is a comparator-versus-circuit band ON THE SAME ITEMS; applied across independently drawn cells it would fire on a healthy generator roughly half the time. SS6.2.1 removes the noise instead of widening the band.

null_not_false_disposition: a cell whose floor has not been run has NO verdict and its booleans are stored as null, NEVER as FALSE (SS18.4). The same disposition applies to SS12.3 (a failed comparator_flat_in_n makes SS12.5's booleans null), SS12.9.4 (an unreadable grade 3), and SS10.4's vacuous single-n groups.

arbiter_doc63_SS10_5.gap_within_0_06_comparator_flat: THE FAMILY SCALES. The circuit tracks the extractable information at every cast size and composition-freedom is not an artefact of n = 2.
arbiter_doc63_SS10_5.gap_degrades_comparator_flat: CIRCUIT-SIDE, AND CLEANLY SO. The information is unchanged and linearly extractable at every n (SS4.5.1, SS10.4); the circuit stops converting it. This is the programme's cleanest trainability instance BECAUSE THE TASK DID NOT CHANGE.
arbiter_doc63_SS10_5.gap_degrades_and_comparator_degrades: `comparator_flat_in_n` has FAILED and the cells are not comparable. NOT A CIRCUIT FINDING OF ANY KIND; hunt the generator.
arbiter_doc63_SS10_5.circuit_exceeds_comparator: reported with BOTH halves of SS10.6's qualifier. It has not happened on any arm of exp67, exp68, exp69, exp70 or exp73.

directional_call_doc63_SS13.why_none: SS13.2: the record does not support a posture; the two committed cc values point in OPPOSITE directions; the n axis has no in-programme precedent at all; and SS4.4's theorem cuts both ways -- inert wires do nothing (stability) while the active ones are ALL entangled into the readout's traced-out complement (degradation).

scope_doc63_SS16: NO QUANTUM READING OF ANY KIND. No exp76 number may appear in a sentence containing 'advantage'.
Not a statement about scaling in general: n_active in {2,3,4,5,7}, T in {2,4,6}, one qubit per referent, one category, one surface, two inventory sizes, 5 seeds, dense simulation.

Not a statement about barren plateaus: no gradient-variance-versus-qubit-count measurement is made, and the parameter count does not grow with qubit count, so the standard construction does not even apply.
Not an MPS result: SS9 emits a certificate about THESE states.
Not novel-filler generalisation: the split is over unseen pairings/casts, not unseen nouns, and V2 is reported UN-GATED for that reason.

NOT A WAZN FINDING. The memberships are PROGRAMMATIC WITH SPOT-CHECK and a different provenance class from doc 51 SS7's user-confirmed contrast. SS3.6.2's bands establish that the classes' separability is NOT an artefact of arc count; SS3.6.3 establishes that the bands do NOT distinguish morphological structure from SEMANTIC COHERENCE, and nisba_yaa's 0.8002 is the standing reason to think the semantic channel is live. NO exp76 NUMBER MAY BE QUOTED AS EVIDENCE THAT AN ENCODING 'CARRIES WAZN'. SS21 item 9's control stays registered-open.
Not a discourse or anaphora result: Q76 resolves the query by VERB IDENTITY (SS4.2 C2).
SS9.6 item 3: `gap_stable_in_n` TRUE together with `entanglement_area_law_like` TRUE is ONE FINDING WEARING TWO NAMES and the two may NOT be presented as mutual support.
confirm_draw_obligation_doc63_SS20_2: ON ANY POSITIVE HEADLINE: a confirm draw at generator seed + 1000, re-running the COMMITTED exp76_datagen.py unmodified, with ALL cells of the affected axis present, the full V-suite and every SS8 and SS10.4 assertion re-run, and the S-shuffle floors RE-DRAWN matched to the fresh draw. doc 47 SS18 is standing and doc 58 SS20 is the reason it is not negotiable.

any raw accuracy-versus-n boolean (SS10.1 is the whole reason)
any (n,T) cell-versus-cell boolean beyond SS12.5's endpoints -- with 5 seeds and an 0.06 bar an 8-way ranking is a knife-edge magnet
any comparison against exp70's, exp72's, exp73's or exp75's arms
any comparison of I24 against exp69's committed 24-noun arms (SS6.3, doc 47 SS18.5)
reported_not_registered_doc63_SS12_11: per-q and per-query-position accuracy; per-surface-order accuracy; val-minus-held-out gap per seed; selected epoch per seed; per-verb accuracy; SS11's purity traces; SS9's certificate QUANTITIES; tier (i) and tier (iii) comparator values; per-seed deltas; the (n,T) ordering.
